content.title: Abercrombie, Urban Outfitters Stock Fall After Holiday Sales Fall Short of Expectations
content.summary: Shares of teen retailers Abercrombie & Fitch and Urban Outfitters were hit hard Monday after they missed Wall Street’s expectations.  Urban Outfitters said it notched record holiday sales while Abercrombie said that both its Hollister and namesake brands did well in December.  Shares of Urban Outfitters dropped 12% and Abercrombie & Fitch slumped 18%.
